page._note: Text and dates shown on the page. 'checked' is the date the layer was last confirmed current against its source; the page marks a layer 'being updated' once checked is older than the page's maximum age for that layer (cpi 400, fatf 150, fto 35, sanc 35 days). Change only through the update procedure; never move 'checked' forward without having checked that layer's sources. 'text' holds the dated phrases in the page's source notes and map key; keep them consistent with 'layers' and 'asof'.
